answer: A Sybil defense charges a non-refundable price per independent identity slot, proven by work or a paid attestation, so speaking twice costs twice. Reputation accrues only to slots that paid, and slots funded from one wallet cluster collapse into one voice. Faking ten IDs means buying ten slots and losing deposits when collusion is caught, turning a cheap opinion flood into a costly gamble, a marble on the scale. The registry publishes each payment, so a forged cluster reads like a fable: many characters, one author. The only whisper left to a Sybil is that doubling accounts doubles the bill.
